No. 402.
Bruce’s Juices, Inc. v. American Can Co.
Argued January 29, 30, 1946.
Decided February 11, 1946.
Cody Fowler and Thurman Arnold argued the cause for petitioner. With them on the brief was R. W. Shackleford, John Lord O’Brian argued the cause for respondent. With him on the brief were Leonard B. Smith, John M. Allison and Harry B. Terrell.
